execution: budgeted_executor_installed; explicit private state and launch required

primary.concurrency: explicit --workers; reserve all wave slots together; drain before next wave; source audits serial and isolated

fallback.provider_route: direct Google Batch API for definite primary refusals/no-image responses
fallback.batch_pilot: at most two fallbacks; inspect returned images before submitting more
fallback.cost_measurement: published batch rates times usage; actual invoice and TRY conversion are not available through the API key

prompt.text: Outpaint the album artwork into one seamless portrait image, aspect ratio 9:16. Reference 1 is the target layout: a 720x1280 canvas containing the original 720x720 square at x=0, y=280, with solid green placeholder areas above and below. Reference 2 is the original square artwork. Keep that square centered, full width, at the same scale and position. Replace only the green placeholders with natural continuations of the existing scene. Preserve the original square's composition, people, faces, text, logos, color, grain, lighting and perspective. Continue lines, surfaces, shadows and clothing across both boundaries without visible seams or sudden color changes. Printed graphics on clothing must stay printed graphics, not become real objects. Do not add new people, new lettering, borders, gradients, blurred copies, mirrored copies or green tint. Return the complete expanded image, not a new cover.

policy.completed_no_image: one fallback attempt only after billing reconciliation
policy.technical_error_429_5xx: bounded backoff on same primary only after charge/status reconciliation; no blind POST retry
policy.ambiguous_timeout_or_lost_response: pause item; reconcile provider generation and billing before fresh POST
policy.successful_image: free source alignment; report SSIM and RGB tolerance as distinct metrics; no center-placement penalty
policy.unreliable_registration_or_partial_sourc: manual review; no fabricated rectangle, no automatic training admission
policy.preservation_or_exterior_quality_fail: manual review; one fallback attempt only when explicitly rejected and budget permits
policy.training_admission: reliable full-source match and human review of source content, outside quality and seams; shifted/scaled source allowed
policy.thresholds: not universally calibrated; no SSIM-only percentage unchanged or auto acceptance threshold
policy.billing: persist every actual attempt, model, prompt hash, settings, request/generation IDs, source/output hashes, actual cost or explicitly unknown; both costs count when fallback is used
policy.paid_execution: requires a separately configured batch size and spending cap before running; collecting covers does not trigger generation
policy.primary_retry_conditions: at most one confirmed transient technical failure after completion/charge reconciliation; never retry a refusal

student_status: Local iOS student is not final or trained by this stage
